function localToWorldDim(r,x,y,z){const v=new T.Vector3(x,y,z+(r.offsetZ||0));return r.g.localToWorld(v)}
function drawSelectedSpeakerDimensions(r){
 clearSelectedDimensions();if(!r||!r.dimsLocal)return;
 const [wmm,hmm,dmm]=r.dimsLocal;const w=wmm/1000,h=hmm/1000,d=dmm/1000;const col=0xd33b52;
 function dl(a,b,text,p){line(G.selectedDims,localToWorldDim(r,...a),localToWorldDim(r,...b),col,1);selectedDimLabels.push({text,pos:localToWorldDim(r,...p),kind:'dim'})}
 if(r.type==='8320'){
   // installed orientation: X=343 width, local Z=406 cabinet length, vertical drop=224 max
   dl([-.343/2,-.26,-.203],[.343/2,-.26,-.203],'宽 343 mm',[0,-.31,-.203]);
   dl([-.25,-.02,-.203],[-.25,-.02,.203],'箱体长 406 mm',[-.30,-.02,0]);
   dl([.25,0,.203],[.25,-.224,.203],'最大下垂 224 mm',[.31,-.112,.203]);
 }else{
   dl([-w/2,-h/2-.10,-d/2],[w/2,-h/2-.10,-d/2],`宽 ${wmm} mm`,[0,-h/2-.16,-d/2]);
   dl([-w/2-.10,-h/2,-d/2],[-w/2-.10,h/2,-d/2],`高 ${hmm} mm`,[-w/2-.17,0,-d/2]);
   dl([w/2+.10,-h/2,-d/2],[w/2+.10,-h/2,d/2],`深 ${dmm} mm`,[w/2+.18,-h/2,0]);
 }
 if(r.type!=='9410'&&r.type!=='8320'){selectedHelper=new T.BoxHelper(r.g,0xd33b52);selectedHelper.material.depthTest=false;selectedHelper.renderOrder=30;root.add(selectedHelper)}selectedDimActive=true;G.selectedDims.visible=true;rebuildLabels();
}
const baseLabels=[{text:'180英寸透声幕',pos:eng(0,821,2680),kind:'base'},{text:'第一排 · 3座',pos:eng(0,5020,1230),kind:'base'},{text:'第二排 · 4座',pos:eng(0,6470,1510),kind:'base'},{text:'后墙机柜 / 投影',pos:eng(0,7560,2440),kind:'base'}];
const angleLabels=[];
function azEl(listener,speaker){const dx=speaker[0]-listener[0],dy=speaker[1]-listener[1],dz=speaker[2]-listener[2];return {az:Math.atan2(dx,-dy)*180/Math.PI,el:Math.atan2(dz,Math.hypot(dx,dy))*180/Math.PI}}
for(const r of speakerRecords){if(r.noAngle||r.type==='4645C')continue;const p=new T.Vector3();r.g.getWorldPosition(p);const epos=[p.x*1000,-p.z*1000,p.y*1000];const a=azEl(r.listener,epos);angleLabels.push({text:`方位角 ${a.az>=0?'+':''}${a.az.toFixed(1)}°`,pos:p.clone().add(new T.Vector3(0,.22,0)),kind:'az'});angleLabels.push({text:`仰角 ${a.el>=0?'+':''}${a.el.toFixed(1)}°`,pos:p.clone().add(new T.Vector3(0,.10,0)),kind:'el'})}
let labelState={base:true,az:false,el:false,dim:false};let selectedDimActive=false;
function rebuildLabels(){const host=$('labels');host.innerHTML='';const all=[];if(labelState.base)all.push(...baseLabels);if(labelState.az)all.push(...angleLabels.filter(x=>x.kind==='az'));if(labelState.el)all.push(...angleLabels.filter(x=>x.kind==='el'));if(labelState.dim)all.push(...dimLabels.map(x=>({...x,kind:'dim'})));if(selectedDimActive)all.push(...selectedDimLabels);for(const item of all){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='scene-label '+(item.kind||'');d.textContent=item.text;d._pos=item.pos;host.append(d)}}rebuildLabels();

return  {labelState,rebuildLabels,clearSelectedDimensions,drawSelectedSpeakerDimensions,get selectedSpeakerRecord(){return selectedSpeakerRecord},set selectedSpeakerRecord(v){selectedSpeakerRecord=v},get selectedDimActive(){return selectedDimActive},set selectedDimActive(v){selectedDimActive=v}};
}

// Extracted from the accepted V18 baseline; geometry is preserved.
function validateGeometry(ctx) {
const {T,$,G,E,speakerRecords,rackBase,rack,proj,sofaRow1,sofaRow2,acousticPanels,equipmentBounds}=ctx;
// ---------- OBB collision helpers ----------
function makeOBB(obj,dimsLocal,offsetZ=0){
 obj.updateMatrixWorld(true);
 const c=new T.Vector3(0,0,offsetZ).applyMatrix4(obj.matrixWorld);
 const q=new T.Quaternion();obj.getWorldQuaternion(q);
 const axes=[new T.Vector3(1,0,0),new T.Vector3(0,1,0),new T.Vector3(0,0,1)].map(a=>a.applyQuaternion(q).normalize());
 return {c,u:axes,e:[dimsLocal[0]/2000,dimsLocal[1]/2000,dimsLocal[2]/2000]};
}
function obbHit(A,B){
 const EPS=1e-7,R=[[],[],[]],AR=[[],[],[]];
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++)for(let j=0;j<3;j++){R[i][j]=A.u[i].dot(B.u[j]);AR[i][j]=Math.abs(R[i][j])+EPS}
 const tv=B.c.clone().sub(A.c),t=A.u.map(a=>tv.dot(a));
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const ra=A.e[i],rb=B.e[0]*AR[i][0]+B.e[1]*AR[i][1]+B.e[2]*AR[i][2];if(Math.abs(t[i])>ra+rb)return false}
 for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const ra=A.e[0]*AR[0][j]+A.e[1]*AR[1][j]+A.e[2]*AR[2][j],rb=B.e[j];const val=Math.abs(t[0]*R[0][j]+t[1]*R[1][j]+t[2]*R[2][j]);if(val>ra+rb)return false}
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++)for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
   const i1=(i+1)%3,i2=(i+2)%3,j1=(j+1)%3,j2=(j+2)%3;
   const ra=A.e[i1]*AR[i2][j]+A.e[i2]*AR[i1][j];
   const rb=B.e[j1]*AR[i][j2]+B.e[j2]*AR[i][j1];
   const val=Math.abs(t[i2]*R[i1][j]-t[i1]*R[i2][j]);
   if(val>ra+rb)return false;
 }
 return true
}
function rec(name){return speakerRecords.find(r=>r.name.includes(name))}
function recordOBB(r){return makeOBB(r.g,r.dimsLocal,r.offsetZ||0)}

// ---------- geometry validation ----------
const issues=[];const checks=[];
function addCheck(ok,label,detail){checks.push({ok,label,detail});if(!ok)issues.push(label+': '+detail)}
function boxInside(obj,label,tol=.025){obj.updateMatrixWorld(true);const b=new T.Box3().setFromObject(obj);const ok=b.min.x>=-2.5-tol&&b.max.x<=2.5+tol&&b.min.y>=-tol&&b.max.y<=2.8+tol&&b.min.z>=-8-tol&&b.max.z<=tol;addCheck(ok,label,`包络 x[${b.min.x.toFixed(3)},${b.max.x.toFixed(3)}] y[${b.min.y.toFixed(3)},${b.max.y.toFixed(3)}] z[${b.min.z.toFixed(3)},${b.max.z.toFixed(3)}] m`)}
for(const r of speakerRecords)boxInside(r.type==='8320'?r.g.children[0]:r.g,r.name, .001);
boxInside(rack,'37U机柜');boxInside(proj,'JVC投影机');
addCheck(Math.abs((5020+600/2)-5320)<1,'第一排靠背贴地台','第一排名义后沿应为 Y=5320 mm');
addCheck(Math.abs((7775+450/2)-8000)<1,'后炮贴后墙','后炮后沿应为 Y=8000 mm');
addCheck(2640<=2800,'180英寸幕框高度','幕框顶边 2640 mm，距结构顶 160 mm');

addCheck(2310<2800,'投影机顶面净空','当前投影机顶面约 2310 mm，距结构顶约 490 mm');
// 机柜基座覆盖与关键 OBB 碰撞
const rackBB=new T.Box3().setFromObject(rack),baseBB=new T.Box3().setFromObject(rackBase);
addCheck(baseBB.min.x<=rackBB.min.x+1e-6&&baseBB.max.x>=rackBB.max.x-1e-6&&baseBB.min.z<=rackBB.min.z+1e-6&&baseBB.max.z>=rackBB.max.z-1e-6,'机柜基座覆盖','720 × 880 mm 基座应完整承托 600 × 800 mm 机柜平面');
const rackObb=makeOBB(rack,[600,1800,800],0);
for(const [label,a,b] of [
 ['Rear 9410 L ↔ SW3',rec('Rear Surround L'),rec('SW3 后左')],
 ['Rear 9410 R ↔ SW4',rec('Rear Surround R'),rec('SW4 后右')],
 ['Rear GHD2 L ↔ Rear 9410 L',rec('KTV RL'),rec('Rear Surround L')],
 ['Rear GHD2 R ↔ Rear 9410 R',rec('KTV RR'),rec('Rear Surround R')],
 ['Front GHD2 L ↔ L/3153',rec('KTV FL'),rec('L / JBL 3153')],
 ['Front GHD2 R ↔ R/3153',rec('KTV FR'),rec('R / JBL 3153')]
])if(a&&b)addCheck(!obbHit(recordOBB(a),recordOBB(b)),'OBB '+label,'方向包围盒不应发生实体重叠');
for(const s of [rec('SW3 后左'),rec('SW4 后右')])if(s)addCheck(!obbHit(rackObb,recordOBB(s)),'OBB 机柜 ↔ '+s.name,'机柜与后低音炮不得实体重叠');
const row2Obb=makeOBB(sofaRow2,[3200,1020,600],0);
addCheck(!obbHit(row2Obb,rackObb),'OBB 第二排沙发 ↔ 机柜','当前直立状态不得与机柜实体重叠；全躺仍需实际座椅尺寸复核');
for(const r of speakerRecords.filter(r=>r.type==='8320')){const b=new T.Box3().setFromObject(r.g.children[0]),assembly=new T.Box3().setFromObject(r.g);addCheck(b.max.y<=2.8001,'8320 箱体顶面净空 '+r.name,`箱体顶 ${(b.max.y*1000).toFixed(0)} mm；安装件最高 ${(assembly.max.y*1000).toFixed(0)} mm，用户确认允许进入顶面结构`)}
const screenSize=new T.Box3().setFromObject(G.screen).getSize(new T.Vector3());
addCheck(Math.abs(screenSize.x-4.105)<1e-6&&Math.abs(screenSize.y-2.360)<1e-6&&Math.abs(screenSize.z-.040)<1e-6,'幕布完整外包络','包含画面及四边框，总尺寸必须为 4105 × 2360 × 40 mm');
for(const panel of acousticPanels){
 const b=new T.Box3().setFromObject(panel);
 const hits=equipmentBounds.filter(e=>b.intersectsBox(e.bounds.clone().expandByScalar(.0499)));
 addCheck(hits.length===0,'后墙模块避让 '+panel.name,'按设备、箱体和支架完整包络预留 50 mm；'+(hits.length?hits.map(h=>h.name).join('、'):'无实体交叠'));
}

const bad=issues.length;$('geometryText').innerHTML=`自动几何检查：<b style="color:${bad?'#e16e6e':'#83c7a3'}">${bad?bad+' 项提醒':'通过'}</b><br>${checks.filter(x=>!x.ok).map(x=>'• '+x.label+' — '+x.detail).join('<br>')||'房间边界、关键 OBB 碰撞、幕框高度、后炮贴墙、机柜基础、第一排与地台关系均满足当前已知几何约束。'}<br><span style="color:#99a9b8">注：OBB 检查针对当前已知箱体外包络；座椅全躺、实际支架、墙面完成层与投影散热仍需实物资料复核。</span>`;$('collisionAlert').classList.toggle('show',bad>0);$('collisionAlert').textContent=bad?`发现 ${bad} 项几何提醒，请在工程页查看。`:'当前已知几何边界未发现硬碰撞。';

return  {checks,issues};
}

// Extracted from the accepted V18 baseline; geometry is preserved.
function createUI(ctx) {
const {T,$,parseAssets,canvas,scene,camera,renderer,eng,G,root,mats,fabricTex,carpetTex,floor,ceiling,leftWall,rightWall,rearWall,frontShellWall,wallShellOriginal,wallXrayEdges,screen,baffleWall,speakerRecords,D}=ctx;
const {labelState,rebuildLabels,clearSelectedDimensions,drawSelectedSpeakerDimensions}=D;
function toast(text){const el=$("toast");el.textContent=text;el.classList.add("show");setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove("show"),1600)}
// ---------- modes / UI ----------
let mode='client',backstageManual=false,lightBg=true,finishEnabled=true,currentView='overview';
const wallXray=true;

function applyBackgroundTheme(show){
  lightBg=show;
  scene.background=new T.Color(show?0xf5f6f8:0x090d12);
  scene.fog=new T.Fog(show?0xf0f2f4:0x090d12,show?15:13,show?34:28);
  document.body.classList.toggle('lightbg',show);
  $('bgToggle').checked=show;
  $('bgBtn').classList.toggle('active',show);
  $('bgBtn').textContent=show?'白色底图：开':'白色底图：关';
}
function applyFinish(show){
  finishEnabled=show;
  G.decor.visible=show;
  $('finishToggle').checked=show;
  $('finishBtn').classList.toggle('active',show);
  $('finishBtn').textContent=show?'装修完成面：开':'装修完成面：关';

  // Finished mode = dark cinema backing + fabric/metal decorative overlay.
  // Raw mode = neutral construction shell, making the difference immediately visible.
  const shellColor=show?0x24292f:0x92938f;
  for(const m of [leftWall,rightWall,rearWall,frontShellWall]){
    m.material.color.setHex(shellColor);
    m.material.map=show?fabricTex:null;
    m.material.roughness=show?.98:.96;
    m.material.needsUpdate=true;
  }
  ceiling.material.color.setHex(show?0x24292f:0x777b80);
  ceiling.material.map=null;ceiling.material.needsUpdate=true;
  if(show){
    floor.material.color.setHex(0x202329);floor.material.map=carpetTex;
  }else{
    floor.material.color.setHex(0x8b8982);floor.material.map=null;
  }
  floor.material.needsUpdate=true;
  // Re-apply xray because xray opacity depends on finish state.
  applyWallXray();
}
function applyWallXray(){
  const show=true;
  floor.material.transparent=show;
  floor.material.opacity=show?.42:1;
  floor.material.depthWrite=!show;
  floor.material.needsUpdate=true;
  // 前结构墙只在透视状态出现，用于表达完整 5×8×2.8 m 结构边界
  frontShellWall.visible=show;
  wallXrayEdges.visible=show;

  wallShellOriginal.forEach(({mesh,opacity,transparent,depthWrite})=>{
    const isCeiling=mesh===ceiling;
    mesh.material.transparent=show?true:transparent;
    mesh.material.opacity=show?(isCeiling?.055:.115):opacity;
    mesh.material.depthWrite=show?false:depthWrite;
    mesh.material.needsUpdate=true;
    // 透视模式时顶部保持可见但极低透明度；关闭透视后由视角逻辑决定顶面显示
    if(mesh===ceiling && show) mesh.visible=true;
  });

  // 装饰完成面始终位于声学芯材的房间侧。
  // 客户/工程模式保持完成面清晰；声学布局模式将驼色布面半透明，以便看到其后的声学材料层。
  G.decor.visible=finishEnabled;
  G.decor.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.material){
    if(o.userData._finishBaseOpacity===undefined)o.userData._finishBaseOpacity=o.userData.baseOpacity??o.material.opacity??1;
    const isGold=o.name?.includes('金色金属腰线');
    const hideGold=isGold && mode!=='client';
    o.visible=!hideGold;
    const targetOpacity=!finishEnabled?0:(mode==='acoustic'?.18:(isGold?.98:.74));
    o.material.transparent=true;
    o.material.opacity=hideGold?0:targetOpacity;
    o.material.depthWrite=mode!=='acoustic';
    o.material.needsUpdate=true;
  }});
}
function colorEdges(show){root.traverse(o=>{if(o.userData&&o.userData.colorEdge)o.visible=show})}
function resetHelpers(){labelState.az=labelState.el=labelState.dim=false;D.selectedDimActive=false;D.selectedSpeakerRecord=null;clearSelectedDimensions();$('axesToggle').checked=$('azToggle').checked=$('elToggle').checked=$('dimsToggle').checked=false;G.axis.visible=G.dims.visible=G.selectedDims.visible=false;['axesBtn','azBtn','elBtn','dimsBtn'].forEach(id=>$(id).classList.remove('active'));rebuildLabels()}
function applyBackstage(show){G.backstage.visible=show;$('backstageToggle').checked=show;$('backstageBtn').classList.toggle('active',show);G.screen.visible=!show;if(typeof baffleWall!=='undefined')baffleWall.visible=!show;mats.screen.opacity=show?.02:1;mats.screen.depthWrite=!show;mats.screen.emissiveIntensity=show?.05:.26;screen.material.needsUpdate=true}
function setMode(v){mode=v;document.body.classList.remove('mode-client','mode-acoustic','mode-engineer');document.body.classList.add('mode-'+v);document.querySelectorAll('[data-mode]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.mode===v));resetHelpers();$('legend').hidden=true;$('legendBtn').classList.remove('active');if(v==='client'){G.acoustic.visible=false;G.engineering.visible=false;colorEdges(false);applyBackstage(backstageManual)}else if(v==='acoustic'){G.acoustic.visible=true;G.engineering.visible=false;colorEdges(false);applyBackstage(true);document.querySelector('[data-tab=acoustics]').click()}else{G.acoustic.visible=false;G.engineering.visible=true;colorEdges(true);applyBackstage(true);document.querySelector('[data-tab=engineering]').click()}applyWallXray()}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-mode]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setMode(b.dataset.mode));
function toggleCheck(id,fn){$(id).onchange=()=>fn($(id).checked)}
toggleCheck('finishToggle',v=>applyFinish(v));toggleCheck('bgToggle',v=>applyBackgroundTheme(v));toggleCheck('labelsToggle',v=>{labelState.base=v;rebuildLabels()});toggleCheck('axesToggle',v=>{G.axis.visible=v;$('axesBtn').classList.toggle('active',v)});toggleCheck('azToggle',v=>{labelState.az=v;$('azBtn').classList.toggle('active',v);rebuildLabels()});toggleCheck('elToggle',v=>{labelState.el=v;$('elBtn').classList.toggle('active',v);rebuildLabels()});toggleCheck('dimsToggle',v=>{G.dims.visible=v;labelState.dim=v;$('dimsBtn').classList.toggle('active',v);rebuildLabels()});toggleCheck('backstageToggle',v=>{backstageManual=v;applyBackstage(v);if(v)setView('backstage')});
$('finishBtn').onclick=()=>{$('finishToggle').checked=!$('finishToggle').checked;$('finishToggle').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))};$('bgBtn').onclick=()=>{$('bgToggle').checked=!$('bgToggle').checked;$('bgToggle').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))};$('axesBtn').onclick=()=>{$('axesToggle').checked=!$('axesToggle').checked;$('axesToggle').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))};$('azBtn').onclick=()=>{$('azToggle').checked=!$('azToggle').checked;$('azToggle').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))};$('elBtn').onclick=()=>{$('elToggle').checked=!$('elToggle').checked;$('elToggle').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))};$('dimsBtn').onclick=()=>{$('dimsToggle').checked=!$('dimsToggle').checked;$('dimsToggle').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))};$('backstageBtn').onclick=()=>{$('backstageToggle').checked=!$('backstageToggle').checked;$('backstageToggle').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))};$('legendBtn').onclick=()=>{$('legend').hidden=!$('legend').hidden;$('legendBtn').classList.toggle('active',!$('legend').hidden)};

document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));document.querySelectorAll('.content[id^=tab-]').forEach(x=>x.hidden=x.id!=='tab-'+b.dataset.tab)});
$('panelBtn').onclick=$('closePanel').onclick=()=>{$('panel').classList.toggle('collapsed');$('panelBtn').textContent=$('panel').classList.contains('collapsed')?'展开侧栏':'收起侧栏'};$('textBtn').onclick=()=>document.body.classList.toggle('text-hidden');$('maxBtn').onclick=()=>{document.body.classList.toggle('maximized');resize()};$('fullBtn').onclick=()=>document.fullscreenElement?document.exitFullscreen():document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.();

// ---------- views / orbit / touch ----------
let target=eng(0,820,1460),drag=null,walk=false,keys={},pointers=new Map(),pinchDist=0;
function setView(v){currentView=v;const presets={mlp:[eng(0,4750,1100),eng(0,821,1460)],row1:[eng(-1300,4700,1280),eng(0,821,1460)],row2:[eng(0,6700,1380),eng(0,821,1460)],front:[eng(0,6900,1900),eng(0,815,1460)],left:[eng(-2250,4300,1500),eng(500,4300,1250)],right:[eng(2250,4300,1500),eng(-500,4300,1250)],rear:[eng(0,1250,1800),eng(0,7600,1450)],top:[new T.Vector3(0,9,-4),new T.Vector3(0,0,-4)],overview:[new T.Vector3(5.35,4.55,-8.20),new T.Vector3(0,1.15,-4.0)],backstage:[eng(1800,3000,1700),eng(0,500,1450)],walk:[eng(0,4750,1500),eng(0,2500,1400)]};const [p,t]=presets[v]||presets.mlp;camera.position.copy(p);target.copy(t);if(innerWidth<760&&['overview','top'].includes(v))camera.position.sub(target).multiplyScalar(Math.max(1,1.45/camera.aspect)).add(target);camera.lookAt(target);walk=v==='walk';
  ceiling.visible=true;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===v));}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setView(b.dataset.view));
canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{pointers.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);if(pointers.size===1)drag={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};if(pointers.size===2){const a=[...pointers.values()];pinchDist=Math.hypot(a[0].x-a[1].x,a[0].y-a[1].y)}});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!pointers.has(e.pointerId))return;pointers.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});if(pointers.size===2){const a=[...pointers.values()],d=Math.hypot(a[0].x-a[1].x,a[0].y-a[1].y);if(pinchDist){const k=T.MathUtils.clamp(pinchDist/d,.92,1.08);camera.position.sub(target).multiplyScalar(k).add(target)}pinchDist=d;return}if(!drag)return;const dx=e.clientX-drag.x,dy=e.clientY-drag.y;drag={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};if(e.buttons===2||e.shiftKey){const right=new T.Vector3();camera.getWorldDirection(right);right.cross(camera.up).normalize();const pan=right.multiplyScalar(-dx*.0045).add(camera.up.clone().multiplyScalar(dy*.0045));camera.position.add(pan);target.add(pan)}else{const off=camera.position.clone().sub(target),s=new T.Spherical().setFromVector3(off);s.theta-=dx*.0055;s.phi=T.MathUtils.clamp(s.phi+dy*.0055,.10,Math.PI-.10);camera.position.copy(target).add(new T.Vector3().setFromSpherical(s))}camera.lookAt(target)});
function pointerEnd(e){pointers.delete(e.pointerId);drag=null;if(pointers.size<2)pinchDist=0}canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',pointerEnd);canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',pointerEnd);canvas.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{e.preventDefault();camera.position.sub(target).multiplyScalar(T.MathUtils.clamp(1+e.deltaY*.001,.84,1.18)).add(target)},{passive:false});


// ---------- acoustic / engineering detail dialogs ----------
const acousticCatalog=[
 {
  test:n=>n.includes('前墙宽频吸声'),
  title:'前墙宽频吸声区',en:'Front-Wall Broadband Absorption',

function acousticInfoFor(name,detail=''){
 const item=acousticCatalog.find(x=>x.test(name));
 return item||{
  title:name,en:'Acoustic Treatment Module',
  role:detail||'声学处理模块。',
  layers:[['房间 / Room','可见侧'],['透声完成面 / Finish','装饰表皮'],['声学处理层 / Treatment','按当前模块用途'],['结构基层 / Structure','墙体 / 地面']],
  construction:detail||'最终结构在施工深化阶段确认。'
 };
}
function esc(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function renderStructure(layers){
 return `<div class="structure-stack">${layers.map((l,i)=>`${i?'<div class="structure-arrow">→</div>':''}<div class="structure-layer"><b>${esc(l[0])}</b><span>${esc(l[1])}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
}
function showAcousticDialog(u){
 const info=acousticInfoFor(u.name,u.detail);
 $('acousticDialogTitle').textContent=u.name;
 $('acousticDialogSub').textContent=info.en;
 $('acousticDialogBody').innerHTML=`
  <div class="info-grid">
   <div class="info-cell"><b>模块功能 / Function</b><span>${esc(info.role)}</span></div>
   <div class="info-cell"><b>位置 / Location</b><span>${esc(u.name)}</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="structure-title">结构层级｜从房间侧 → 结构基层</div>
  ${renderStructure(info.layers)}
  <div class="structure-title">当前模块建议</div>
  <div class="acoustic-copy">${esc(u.detail||info.role)}</div>
  <div class="structure-title">施工结构说明</div>
  <div class="acoustic-copy">${esc(info.construction)}</div>`;
 $('acousticDialog').classList.add('open');
}

function channelInfo(name){
 const hit=channelCatalog.find(x=>x[0].test(name));
 return hit?{zh:hit[1],en:hit[2]}:{zh:name.split('/')[0].trim(),en:'Channel'};
}
function renderProductSpecs(type){
 const specs=productSpecs[type]||[];
 if(!specs.length)return '<div class="acoustic-copy">当前项目资料未锁定该型号的更多产品参数。</div>';
 return `<div class="info-grid">${specs.map(([k,v])=>`<div class="info-cell"><b>${esc(k)}</b><span>${esc(v)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
}
function findPhotoByName(part){
 return photos.find(p=>p.name.includes(part))?.url||'';
}
function productImage(type){
 if(type==='9410' && window.__speaker9410ProductImage)return window.__speaker9410ProductImage;
 if(type==='3153')return parseAssets.modelTextures?.['3153']||findPhotoByName('3159');
 if(type==='8320')return parseAssets.modelTextures?.['8320']||findPhotoByName('8320_front');
 if(type==='9410')return parseAssets.modelTextures?.['9410']||findPhotoByName('9400-Front');
 if(type==='GHD2')return parseAssets.modelTextures?.['GHD2']||findPhotoByName('GHD2_Front');
 if(type==='4645C')return findPhotoByName('image_processing20260727-1-1hdckq');
 return '';
}
function showSpeakerDialog(record){
 const ch=channelInfo(record.name),img=productImage(record.type);
 $('speakerDialogTitle').textContent=`${ch.zh} / ${ch.en}`;
 $('speakerDialogSub').textContent=`JBL ${record.type}`;
 $('speakerDialogBody').innerHTML=`
  <div class="product-layout">
   <div>
    <div class="product-image-wrap">${img?`<img src="${img}" alt="JBL ${esc(record.type)}">`:'<span style="color:#697b88">暂无产品图片</span>'}</div>
   </div>
   <div>
    <div class="info-grid">
     <div class="info-cell"><b>声道名称</b><span>${esc(ch.zh)}</span></div>
     <div class="info-cell"><b>Channel</b><span>${esc(ch.en)}</span></div>
     <div class="info-cell"><b>产品型号 / Model</b><span>JBL ${esc(record.type)}</span></div>
     <div class="info-cell"><b>箱体尺寸 / Cabinet Size</b><span>${esc(productDims[record.type]||'—')}<br><small>高 × 宽 × 深 / H × W × D</small></span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="structure-title">产品参数 / Specifications</div>
    ${renderProductSpecs(record.type)}
   </div>
  </div>`;
 $('speakerDialog').classList.add('open');
}
$('acousticDialogClose').onclick=()=>$('acousticDialog').classList.remove('open');
$('speakerDialogClose').onclick=()=>$('speakerDialog').classList.remove('open');
$('acousticDialog').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===$('acousticDialog'))$('acousticDialog').classList.remove('open')});
$('speakerDialog').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===$('speakerDialog'))$('speakerDialog').classList.remove('open')});

// ---------- click selection ----------
function visibleInHierarchy(object){for(let p=object;p;p=p.parent)if(!p.visible)return false;return true}
function firstHit(objects){
 const hits=ray.intersectObjects(objects,true);
 return hits.find(h=>h.object.userData&&h.object.userData.name&&visibleInHierarchy(h.object));
}
const ray=new T.Raycaster(),ptr=new T.Vector2();
canvas.addEventListener('click',e=>{
 if(Math.abs(e.movementX||0)>3||Math.abs(e.movementY||0)>3)return;
 const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 ptr.set((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*2-1,-(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*2+1);
 ray.setFromCamera(ptr,camera);

 // 声学模式：只响应声学模块。音箱点击在该模式下不显示尺寸、不弹产品信息。
 if(mode==='acoustic'){
   D.selectedDimActive=false;D.selectedSpeakerRecord=null;clearSelectedDimensions();rebuildLabels();
   const hit=firstHit(G.acoustic.children);
   if(!hit)return;
   const u=hit.object.userData;
   $('acousticInfo').textContent=(u.name+'：'+(u.detail||''));
   document.querySelector('[data-tab=acoustics]').click();
   showAcousticDialog(u);
   return;
 }

 // 工程模式：只响应扬声器，显示双语声道、尺寸、型号、产品图片。
 if(mode==='engineer'){
   const speakerRoots=speakerRecords.map(s=>s.g);
   const hit=firstHit(speakerRoots);
   if(!hit)return;
   const u=hit.object.userData;
   const record=speakerRecords.find(s=>s.name===u.name);
   if(!record)return;
   D.selectedSpeakerRecord=record;
   drawSelectedSpeakerDimensions(record);
   $('selectionTitle').textContent=record.name;
   $('selectionBody').textContent=u.detail||'JBL 扬声器。';
   showSpeakerDialog(record);
   return;
 }

 // 客户模式：保留普通对象说明，不主动绘制工程尺寸。
 const hit=firstHit(root.children);
 if(!hit)return;
 const u=hit.object.userData;
 $('selectionTitle').textContent=u.name;
 $('selectionBody').textContent=u.detail||'影院模型对象。';
 D.selectedDimActive=false;D.selectedSpeakerRecord=null;clearSelectedDimensions();rebuildLabels();
 document.querySelector('[data-tab=equipment]').click();
});

// ---------- product photo references ----------
const photos=parseAssets.photos;$('photoGrid').innerHTML=photos.map((p,i)=>`<button data-photo="${i}"><img src="${p.url}"><span>${p.name.replaceAll('&','&amp;')}</span></button>`).join('');let pi=0;function photo(i){pi=(i+photos.length)%photos.length;$('photoTitle').textContent=photos[pi].name;$('photoImage').src=photos[pi].url;$('photoCount').textContent=`${pi+1} / ${photos.length}`;$('photoDialog').classList.add('open')}document.querySelectorAll('[data-photo]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>photo(+b.dataset.photo));$('photoClose').onclick=()=>$('photoDialog').classList.remove('open');$('photoPrev').onclick=()=>photo(pi-1);$('photoNext').onclick=()=>photo(pi+1);

function resize(){const w=canvas.clientWidth,h=canvas.clientHeight;if(w&&h){renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,w<760?1.2:1.8));renderer.setSize(w,h,false);const oldAspect=camera.aspect;camera.aspect=w/h;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();if((oldAspect<.8)!==(camera.aspect<.8)&&['overview','top'].includes(currentView))setView(currentView)}}new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas);resize();
function updateDomLabels(){const w=canvas.clientWidth,h=canvas.clientHeight;document.querySelectorAll('.scene-label').forEach(el=>{const p=el._pos;if(!p)return;const v=p.clone().project(camera);const behind=v.z>1||v.z<-1;el.style.left=(v.x+1)*w/2+'px';el.style.top=(1-v.y)*h/2+'px';el.style.display=behind?'none':''})}
function frame(){if(window.__cinemaDebug.fatalError)return;if(walk){const f=new T.Vector3();camera.getWorldDirection(f);f.y=0;f.normalize();const right=new T.Vector3().crossVectors(f,camera.up).normalize();const speed=.026;if(keys.KeyW||keys.ArrowUp)camera.position.addScaledVector(f,speed);if(keys.KeyS||keys.ArrowDown)camera.position.addScaledVector(f,-speed);if(keys.KeyA||keys.ArrowLeft)camera.position.addScaledVector(right,-speed);if(keys.KeyD||keys.ArrowRight)camera.position.addScaledVector(right,speed);camera.position.x=T.MathUtils.clamp(camera.position.x,-2.30,2.30);camera.position.z=T.MathUtils.clamp(camera.position.z,-7.70,-.90);camera.position.y=T.MathUtils.clamp(camera.position.y,.9,2.3);target.copy(camera.position).add(f.multiplyScalar(2));camera.lookAt(target)}renderer.render(scene,camera);ctx.onRendered();updateDomLabels();requestAnimationFrame(frame)}addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.code]=true;if(e.key==='Escape'&&document.fullscreenElement)document.exitFullscreen()});addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.code]=false);


return {setView,setMode,applyFinish,applyWallXray,applyBackgroundTheme,start(){applyBackgroundTheme(true);applyFinish(true);applyWallXray();setView("overview");setMode("client");frame()},state(){return {mode,wallXray,lightBg,finishEnabled,walk,currentView,camera:camera.position.toArray(),target:target.toArray()}}};
}


async function boot(){
 const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
 const parseAssets=window.__cinemaEmbeddedAssets||await fetch('assets/catalog.json').then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('本地资源目录加载失败');return r.json()});
 $('brandLogo').src=parseAssets.logo;
 const ctx={T,$,parseAssets,E,colors,ACOUSTIC_PALETTE};
 Object.assign(ctx,createScene(ctx));
 Object.assign(ctx,createMaterials(ctx));
 for(const chip of document.querySelectorAll('[data-palette]'))chip.style.backgroundColor='#'+ACOUSTIC_PALETTE[chip.dataset.palette].toString(16).padStart(6,'0');
 const patterns={sideSlat:ctx.acousticSwatches.sideSlat,rearDiffuser:ctx.acousticSwatches.rearDiffuser};
 for(const chip of document.querySelectorAll('[data-pattern]'))chip.style.backgroundImage=`url(${patterns[chip.dataset.pattern]})`;
 Object.assign(ctx,createGeometry(ctx));
 Object.assign(ctx,createRoom(ctx));
 Object.assign(ctx,createSpeakers(ctx));
 Object.assign(ctx,createSeating(ctx));
 Object.assign(ctx,createEquipment(ctx));
 Object.assign(ctx,createAcoustics(ctx));
 ctx.D=createDimensions(ctx);
 Object.assign(ctx,validateGeometry(ctx));
 const debug=window.__cinemaDebug;
 debug.counts={...ctx.speakerRecords.reduce((a,r)=>(a[r.type]=(a[r.type]||0)+1,a),{}),speakers:ctx.speakerRecords.length,subs:ctx.speakerRecords.filter(r=>r.type==='4645C').length,sofas:2,roomMeshes:ctx.G.room.children.filter(m=>m.isMesh).length};
 debug.checks=ctx.checks;
 debug.webglRenderer=ctx.renderer.isWebGLRenderer;
 debug.palette=ACOUSTIC_PALETTE;
 debug.deliveryAudit=()=>({
   screenSize:new T.Box3().setFromObject(ctx.G.screen).getSize(new T.Vector3()).toArray(),
   baffleVisible:ctx.baffleWall.visible&&ctx.root.visible,
   floor:{opacity:ctx.floor.material.opacity,depthWrite:ctx.floor.material.depthWrite,transparent:ctx.floor.material.transparent},
   rearPanels:ctx.acousticPanels.map(o=>({name:o.name,min:new T.Box3().setFromObject(o).min.toArray(),max:new T.Box3().setFromObject(o).max.toArray()})),
   equipment:ctx.equipmentBounds.map(o=>({name:o.name,min:o.bounds.min.toArray(),max:o.bounds.max.toArray()})),
   wideBounds:ctx.speakerRecords.filter(r=>r.name.includes('Front Wide')).map(r=>({name:r.name,min:new T.Box3().setFromObject(r.g).min.toArray(),max:new T.Box3().setFromObject(r.g).max.toArray()})),
   acousticMaterials:['acousticMineral','acousticFirst','acousticRear','acousticBass','acousticSlat','acousticDiffuser'].map(k=>({name:k,type:ctx.mats[k].type,toneMapped:ctx.mats[k].toneMapped}))
 });
 debug.acousticColors={frontBroadband:ctx.mats.acousticMineral.color.getHex(),firstReflection:ctx.mats.acousticFirst.color.getHex(),rearAbsorption:ctx.mats.acousticRear.color.getHex(),bassTreatment:ctx.mats.acousticBass.color.getHex(),sideSlat:ctx.mats.acousticSlat.color.getHex(),rearDiffuser:ctx.mats.acousticDiffuser.color.getHex()};
 debug.speakers=ctx.speakerRecords.map(r=>({name:r.name,type:r.type,position:r.g.position.toArray(),rotation:r.g.rotation.toArray(),dims:r.dimsLocal,children:r.g.children.length,geometry:r.g.children.map(c=>c.children.map(m=>m.geometry?.attributes?.position?Array.from(m.geometry.attributes.position.array):[]))}));
 debug.sceneSummary=()=>({renderer:ctx.renderer.info.render,counts:debug.counts,ui:ctx.ui?.state(),surfaces:{decorVisible:ctx.G.decor.visible,acousticVisible:ctx.G.acoustic.visible,backstageVisible:ctx.G.backstage.visible,screenVisible:ctx.G.screen.visible,wallColor:ctx.leftWall.material.color.getHex(),floorColor:ctx.floor.material.color.getHex(),ceilingVisible:ctx.ceiling.visible},sofas:[ctx.sofaRow1,ctx.sofaRow2].map(g=>{const b=new T.Box3().setFromObject(g);return {name:g.userData.name,min:b.min.toArray(),max:b.max.toArray(),width:b.max.x-b.min.x,depth:b.max.z-b.min.z}}),redSofaFrames:[ctx.sofaRow1,ctx.sofaRow2].flatMap(g=>{const found=[];g.traverse(o=>{if(o.isLineSegments)found.push(o.uuid)});return found})});
 // Readiness follows a successful renderer.render, never a timer or CSS override.
 ctx.onRendered=()=>{
   if(ctx.renderer.getContext().isContextLost())throw new Error('WebGL 上下文已丢失');
   debug.frames++;
   if(!debug.sceneReady){debug.sceneReady=true;window.__sceneReady=true;$('loading').classList.add('done');}
 };
 ctx.canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost',event=>{event.preventDefault();window.__reportCinemaError(new Error('WebGL 上下文丢失，请重新加载页面'));});
 ctx.ui=createUI(ctx);debug.ui=ctx.ui;debug.projectSpeaker=(name)=>{const r=ctx.speakerRecords.find(r=>r.name===name);if(!r)return null;const v=r.axisOrigin.clone().project(ctx.camera),rect=ctx.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:rect.left+(v.x+1)*rect.width/2,y:rect.top+(1-v.y)*rect.height/2}};
 ctx.ui.start();
}
boot().catch(window.__reportCinemaError);


window.__speaker9410ProductImage='data:image/png;base64,';
</script>
</body></html>
